pullRequests.title: ci(progress): leave jp and kr out of the releases' agreement check for now
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: ci/skip-jp-kr-sync
pullRequests.body: The jp and kr discs (SCPS_150.56, SCKA_200.11) aren't available here, so their reports can't be rebuilt after each batch, and the agreement check failed master. This adds a SYNC_SKIP set to leave them out. Each release's own --check still runs. Remove the set once someone with those discs rebuilds the reports.
